data.body_html:
Feria San Bernabé 2043 (10–15 June) is Marbella’s biggest street party: fairground rides, flamenco, and casetas packed with locals and visitors. But why spend the whole day on land? A Feria San Bernabé 2043 boat party Marbella lets you combine the sea breeze with the fair’s energy. Depart from Puerto Banús, cruise along the Golden Mile, anchor for a swim, and return in time for the evening festivities. This guide covers the best yachts, pricing, and insider tips for your boat party.

Why a Boat Party During Feria San Bernabé?

The June sun in Marbella averages 28°C, and the Mediterranean is warm enough for swimming by mid-month. A boat party offers a unique perspective: you can anchor off Cala del Faro or near the Marbella Marina, watch the fairground lights from the water, and enjoy unlimited drinks without queuing at a bar. All our charters include a skipper, fuel, drinks (water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava), and light snacks – plus 21% VAT. No hidden extras.

Best Yachts for a Feria San Bernabé Boat Party

Our fleet departs from Puerto Banús, a 5-minute taxi from the Recinto Ferial. Here are the top choices for groups:

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) – €749/2h or €2,299/8h. Ideal for a small group wanting an affordable luxury experience.
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – same Tier A pricing. Spacious cockpit and sunpad.
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – from €4,719/4h, includes a free jet ski. Perfect for a larger party with water toys.
  • Mangusta 80 (Grey) – identical spec, different colour. Same price and inclusions.
  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) – pricing on request via WhatsApp. Flybridge for panoramic views.
  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) – the flagship, for those who want maximum space and style.

For smaller groups, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) are budget-friendly options – pricing on request.

Sample Itinerary: 4-Hour Boat Party

A typical 4-hour charter during Feria San Bernabé might look like this:

  • 16:00 – Board at Puerto Banús. Meet your skipper, enjoy welcome cava.
  • 16:15 – Depart east towards Marbella. Pass under the Río Verde bridge.
  • 16:45 – Anchor near Cala del Faro or Playa de la Fontanilla. Swim, use the jet ski (if on Mangusta 80), or just sunbathe.
  • 18:00 – Cruise back to Puerto Banús, with snacks and drinks served.
  • 18:30 – Disembark. Taxi to Recinto Ferial for the evening fair.

You can customise the route: sail west to Cala Cortés or Estepona if you prefer quieter coves.

Pricing & Booking Tips

Book early – Feria San Bernabé is peak season. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours, rising to €2,299 for 8 hours. The Mangusta 80 is €4,719 for 4 hours (jet ski included). All other yachts are priced on request via WhatsApp. We recommend a minimum of 3–4 hours to enjoy the coast properly. Browse our full fleet and message us for availability.

What to Bring for a Boat Party

Pack sunscreen (SPF 50+), a towel, sunglasses, and a light jacket for the evening breeze. You can bring your own food and decorations – we provide a cooler and plastic cups. No glass on board. If you’d like a catering platter (e.g., jamón, cheese, olives), let us know 48 hours in advance.

Feria San Bernabé 2043: Key Dates

The fair runs from 10 June (Thursday) to 15 June (Tuesday). The main events are:

  • 10 June – Opening night, with the lighting of the fairgrounds.
  • 11–14 June – Daily casetas, live music, and rides.
  • 15 June – Closing night with fireworks (visible from the sea).

Boat parties are popular on the weekend (11–12 June) and the final night. Book your charter to coincide with the fireworks for a magical view from the water.
